title: Describe the decay
question: Does the model describe the intravenous decay of A?

factors.name: Software quality assurance
factors.statement: pkpdsim and sbmlsim are released packages with tests and continuous integration; the model is released reproducibly from its repository with the versions and the commit of the provenance.

factors.name: Numerical code verification
factors.statement: sbmlsim runs the SBML Test Suite and the PEtab test suite.
